Cue: Capturing exit code from a failing command
Text: Append "2>&1; echo \"EXIT: $?\"" to the command to capture stderr and print the exit code.

Failed:
```
error: E42
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme release notes 2\u003e\u00261; echo \"EXIT: $?\""}
```

Cue: Makefile fails with "workspace not initialised" error
Text: Run the bootstrap command first, chained with the make command, to initialise the workspace before running tests.

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"make bootstrap \u0026\u0026 make test","timeout":120}
```

Cue: running migrate.sh status fails due to missing database configuration
Text: always include the --db argument with a valid connection string when calling migrate.sh

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db","timeout":30}
```
